notes: Keys are JWK (P-256); public keys and envelope fields are base64url without padding.
seal: with ephemeral_jwk fixed, sealing plaintext to recipient_public for context gives exactly envelope; every intermediate (shared_secret, aad, key, nonce, padded) is given.

open: the recipient (direction in = the signer, out = the browser), bound to bound.workspace_id and bound.request_id when it was made, opens envelope for context; expect is 'ok' (the plaintext of the base seal vector) or a refusal reason.
replay and the view_digest pin are stateful (a second open of the same epk is 'replay'; after a first open, another view_digest is 'context') and are not vectors.
